title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while Smart Falcon and I are out together…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh hey, look at that! ☆ What adorable plushies! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's looking at a claw machine filled with little Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I bet surrounding myself with these adorable things will up my Umadol power! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: In that case, I've got a request for you. ☆ I'd just love it if you could get me some plushies! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I'll be cheering you on with all my spirit!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I believe in you, Trainer! You got this! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like I'm getting roped into this. All the same…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
